sections.heading: Pathophysiology & Transcellular Shift Dynamics of Hypokalemic Periodic Paralysis
sections.content:
### 1. Topology & Molecular Mechanism Matrix

Hypokalemic Periodic Paralysis (HPP) 是一種急性的 Flaccid Paralysis，臨床特徵為 Serum Potassium 濃度劇烈下降（常小於 2.5 mEq/L）。其核心病理機轉在於大量的 Transcellular Potassium Shift，將 Extracellular Fluid (ECF) 中的 Potassium 迅速移入 Intracellular Fluid (ICF)，特別是 Skeletal Muscle Cell 內部，而非真正的 Total Body Potassium Deficit。當 Sarcolemma 上的 Na+/K+-ATPase 受到異常 Hyperactivation 時，離子幫浦過度將 3 個 Na+ 泵出 Extracellular Space、並將 2 個 K+ 泵入 Intracellular Space，導致嚴重的 Intracellular Potassium Sequestration。

常見的 Trigger Factors 包括大量 Carbohydrate Ingestion，刺激 Pancreatic Beta Cells 分泌大量 Insulin；以及 Post-exercise Rest 或 Stress，激發高活性的 Beta-2 Adrenergic Stimuli。Insulin 與 Epinephrine 皆能透過 Membrane Receptors 活化 Signaling Cascade，強烈刺激 Na+/K+-ATPase 的轉運速率。

在診斷分流上，由於體內並無實質的 Potassium Deficit 或 Renal Loss，Renal Tubular Epithelium 會做出生理性反應，極力保留 Potassium。因此在發作期間，Urine Analysis 會展現特徵性的低 Potassium Excretion Profile：Spot Urine K+ < 20 mEq/L、Transtubular Potassium Gradient (TTKG) < 3，以及 Fractional Excretion of Potassium (FEK) < 1.5%。

| Compartment / Molecule | Physiological Location | Primary Action in HPP | Impact on Potassium Gradient | Associated Clinical Phenotype |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Na+/K+-ATPase | Skeletal Muscle Sarcolemma | Hyperactivated by Insulin & Beta-2 Agonists | Massive ECF to ICF K+ influx | Sudden severe Hypokalemic Flaccid Paralysis |
| Beta-2 Adrenergic Receptor | Skeletal Muscle Membrane | Activated by Epinephrine surge during stress/rest | Stimulates cAMP-PKA pathway to drive Na+/K+-ATPase | Post-exercise or stress-induced paralytic attacks |
| Insulin Receptor | Skeletal Muscle Membrane | Activated by postprandial glucose spike | Promotes GLUT4 translocation & Na+/K+-ATPase uptake | Carbohydrate-rich meal triggered paralysis |
| Cortical Collecting Duct (CCD) | Renal Tubular Epithelium | Intact renal retention response | Spot Urine K+ < 20 mEq/L, TTKG < 3 | Normal renal preservation, zero renal potassium wasting |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Clinical / Lab Parameter | Transcellular Shift (HPP / TPP) | True Total Body Potassium Deficit (RTA / Gitelman) | Gastrointestinal Loss (Diarrhea) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Total Body Potassium Store** | Normal (No net body loss) | Severely Depleted | Severely Depleted |
| **Spot Urine K+** | < 20 mEq/L (Low) | > 20 mEq/L (High renal wasting) | < 20 mEq/L (Appropriate retention) |
| **TTKG Index** | < 3 | > 4 | < 3 |
| **Acid-Base Profile** | Normal (Normal Arterial pH) | Metabolic Acidosis (RTA) or Alkalosis (Gitelman) | Normal Anion Gap Metabolic Acidosis |
| **Rebound Risk post-K+ Supplementation** | High Risk of Rebound Hyperkalemia (40–50%) | Low Risk (Requires massive deficit replacement) | Low Risk |
| **Primary Therapeutic Goal** | Block Na+/K+-ATPase hyperactivation (Beta-blocker) | Replace deficient potassium deficit + Treat cause | Replace volume and potassium deficit |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Trigger Exposure (Carbohydrate Load / Post-Exercise Rest / Stress) ➔ Sympathetic Adrenergic Surge & Postprandial Insulin Secretion ➔ Binding to Beta-2 Receptors & Insulin Receptors on Skeletal Muscle ➔ Cascade Activation of cAMP-PKA & Tyrosine Kinase Pathways ➔ Sarcolemmal Na+/K+-ATPase Hyperactivation ➔ Massive Inward Shift of Extracellular K+ into Skeletal Muscle Intracellular Fluid ➔ Severe ECF Hypokalemia (< 2.5 mEq/L) ➔ Reduced ECF K+ triggers paradoxical membrane depolarization & sodium channel inactivation ➔ Acute Skeletal Muscle Inexcitability & Flaccid Paralysis ➔ Cortical Collecting Duct (CCD) retains K+ (Spot K+ < 20 mEq/L, TTKG < 3).

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 臨床遇到 Hypokalemic Paralysis 病患時，未經評估即投予大劑量 IV KCl (IV KCl > 40 mEq/hr)。
**Analysis**: HPP 的核心在於 Transcellular Shift，身體的 Total Body Potassium 總量並未減少。當發作終止或 Trigger 消除後，被封存在 Skeletal Muscle Cells 內的 Potassium 會大量釋放回 ECF。若在發作期過度給予高劑量 Potassium 補充，當 Skeletal Muscle 內的 Potassium 釋放回 Bloodstream 時，極易引發致命性的 Rebound Hyperkalemia（發生率高達 40-50%），導致 Arrhythmia。正確策略為謹慎小劑量補充 (PO/IV KCl <= 10 mEq/hr)，或給予 Non-selective Beta-blockers 阻斷轉移。

modules.moduleTitle: Module 2: Molecular Channelopathies & Hereditary Subtypes (FHypoPP1, FHypoPP2, Andersen-Tawil Syndrome)
modules.studyGuide: 掌握遺傳性 Hypokalemic Periodic Paralysis 的三大主要亞型：FHypoPP1 (CACNA1S Gene Mutation)、FHypoPP2 (SCN4A Gene Mutation) 以及 Andersen-Tawil Syndrome (KCNJ2 Gene Mutation)。特別深入理解 S4 Voltage Sensor 上 Arginine Mutation 引發的 Gating Pore Leak Current (Omega Current) 如何造成低電解質下的 Paradoxical Sarcolemmal Depolarization。

diagrams.caption: Brenner 11e Ch 17 Fig 17.8: Skeletal Muscle Voltage-Gated Channel Mutations (CACNA1S, SCN4A) & Gating Pore Leak
AI Medical Illustration: Molecular Channelopathies (FHypoPP1, FHypoPP2, KCNJ2) & Omega Current Gating Leak Physiology

sections.heading: Molecular Channelopathies & Hereditary Subtypes (FHypoPP1, FHypoPP2, Andersen-Tawil Syndrome)
sections.content:
### 1. Topology & Molecular Subtype Matrix

Hereditary Familial Hypokalemic Periodic Paralysis (FHypoPP) 屬於 Autosomal Dominant 的單基因 Ion Channelopathies。最常見的亞型為 FHypoPP1 (占 55–70%)，源自 CACNA1S Gene Mutation，該基因編碼 Skeletal Muscle L-type Voltage-Gated Calcium Channel (Cav1.1) 的 alpha-1S subunit。第二常見的亞型為 FHypoPP2 (占 20–30%)，由 SCN4A Gene Mutation 引起，編碼 Skeletal Muscle Voltage-Gated Sodium Channel (Nav1.4) 的 alpha subunit。

在生物物理學上，這些 Point Mutations 多發生於 Voltage-Sensing Domain (S4 Segment) 的帶正電 Arginine Residues。當 Arginine 被中性或較小 Amino Acids 取代時，Ion Channel Protein 會在 Voltage Sensor 旁形成一個異常的非選擇性 Leak Pathway，稱為 Gating Pore Leak Current (亦稱 Omega Current)。在生理 Extracellular K+ 濃度下，Omega Current 保持關閉；但當 Serum K+ 下降時，這條 Leak Pathway 會產生持續性的跨膜微弱 Inward Cation Influx (Na+ 或 H+ Influx)，引發 Sarcolemma 的 Paradoxical Depolarization。Resting Membrane Potential Depolarization 進一步導致 Voltage-Gated Sodium Channels 進入慢性 Inactivation State，使 Skeletal Muscle Cells 失去產生 Action Potential 的能力，引發 Paralysis。

另一極高分亞型為 Andersen-Tawil Syndrome (ATS / FHypoPP3)，源自 KCNJ2 Gene Mutation，編碼 Inward Rectifier Potassium Channel 2.1 (Kir2.1)。ATS 展現經典的 Classic Triad：(1) Periodic Paralysis、(2) Development Dysmorphic Features（Micrognathia、Low-set Ears、Clinodactyly/Syndactyly）、3 Cardiac Arrhythmias（ECG 上顯著 QU Prolongation、Prominent U waves 與 Characteristic Bidirectional Ventricular Tachycardia）。

| Subtype | Mutated Gene | Protein / Channel | Inheritance | Key Biophysical Defect | Unique Clinical Features |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FHypoPP1 | CACNA1S | Cav1.1 (L-type Ca2+ channel) | Autosomal Dominant | S4 Arginine mutation → Gating pore leak (Omega current) | Most common subtype; Responsive to Acetazolamide |
| FHypoPP2 | SCN4A | Nav1.4 (Voltage sodium channel) | Autosomal Dominant | S4 Arginine mutation → Inward Na+/H+ omega current leak | May show paradoxical worsening with Acetazolamide |
| Andersen-Tawil (ATS) | KCNJ2 | Kir2.1 (Inward rectifier K+ channel) | Autosomal Dominant | Loss of Kir2.1 function → Impaired resting potential stability | Triad: Paralysis + Dysmorphism + Bidirectional VT |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature | FHypoPP1 (CACNA1S) | FHypoPP2 (SCN4A) | Andersen-Tawil Syndrome (KCNJ2) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Gene** | CACNA1S (1q32) | SCN4A (17q23) | KCNJ2 (17q24) |
| **Dominant Channel Impacted** | Cav1.1 Calcium Channel | Nav1.4 Sodium Channel | Kir2.1 Potassium Channel |
| **Cardiac Involvement** | Absent | Absent | Frequent (Prominent U wave, QU prolongation, Bidirectional VT) |
| **Dysmorphic Features** | Absent | Absent | Present (Micrognathia, Low-set ears, Clinodactyly) |
| **Response to Acetazolamide** | Prophylaxis Effective | Variable / Potential Exacerbation | Modest response (requires Antiarrhythmics) |
| **Myotonia Association** | Absent | Rare | Absent |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Point Mutation in Voltage-Sensing S4 Segment (Arginine Substitution) of CACNA1S or SCN4A ➔ Structural Disruption of Ion Pathway Canal ➔ Formation of Gating Pore Leak Pathway (Omega Current) ➔ Exposure to Low Extracellular K+ Concentration ➔ Continuous Inward Influx of Na+ & H+ through Gating Pore ➔ Paradoxical Sarcolemmal Depolarization ➔ Continuous Voltage-Gated Na+ Channel (Nav1.4) Inactivation ➔ Failure of Action Potential Generation & Propagation ➔ Severe Skeletal Muscle Paralysis.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為 Hypokalemic Environment 必定會使 Resting Membrane Potential 呈 Hyperpolarization。
**Analysis**: 在正常 Skeletal Muscle 中，Hypokalemic Environment 確實會透過 Nernst Equation 使 K+ Equilibrium Potential 更負（Hyperpolarization）。然而在具有 FHypoPP Gene Mutation 的病患中，當 ECF K+ 下降時，Gating Pore (Omega Current) 的 Inward Na+ Leak Current 會超越 K+ Efflux 的影響，引發「Paradoxical Sarcolemmal Depolarization」。Depolarization 使 Voltage-Gated Sodium Channels 處於持久的 Inactivation State，這才是造成 Skeletal Muscle 無法傳導 Action Potential 與 Paralysis 的根本分子物理學原因。此外，在 SCN4A Mutation 患者中，使用 Acetazolamide 預防發作可能誘發 Paradoxical Exacerbation，需密切評估。

modules.moduleTitle: Module 3: Thyrotoxic Periodic Paralysis (TPP) Clinical Spectrum & Emergency Management
modules.studyGuide: 掌握 TPP 專屬於 Asian Male Predominance 的流行病學特徵，理解 Thyroid Hormone 如何轉錄性上調 Na+/K+-ATPase 及其與 KCNJ18 (Kir2.6) 通道變異的協同作用。熟記急診急性期使用 Non-selective Beta-blocker (Propranolol) 阻斷 shift 的首選地位，以及嚴禁高劑量補鉀以防範 Rebound Hyperkalemia 的核心鐵律。

sections.heading: Thyrotoxic Periodic Paralysis (TPP) Clinical Spectrum & Emergency Management
sections.content:
### 1. Topology & Clinical Spectrum Matrix

Thyrotoxic Periodic Paralysis (TPP) 是一種 Acquired 且可逆的 Hypokalemic Paralysis 急症，極常見於年輕 Asian Males。儘管 Hyperthyroidism (Graves Disease) 在女性的發病率高出男性 9 倍，但 TPP 的男女發生率卻呈極端的倒轉比例（Male-to-Female ratio 高達 20:1）。這反映了 Androgens 可能進一步增強 Na+/K+-ATPase 活性與 Expression Levels 的生理效應。

在分子病理學上，過量的 Thyroid Hormones (T3/T4) 透過兩大途徑強烈驅動 Transcellular Shift：第一，T3 直接結合至 Na+/K+-ATPase 基因的 Thyroid Hormone Response Element (TRE)，上調其 Gene Transcription 與 Protein Translation；第二，Thyroid Hormones 增加 Skeletal Muscle Membrane 上 Beta-2 Adrenergic Receptors 的 Density 與 Sensitivity。近年基因研究更證實，高達 33% 的 TPP 患者帶有 KCNJ18 Gene Mutation（編碼 Inward Rectifier Potassium Channel Kir2.6）， Kir2.6 的功能缺陷使得 Skeletal Muscle Cells 在 Thyroid Hormones 刺激下更易發生 Membrane Potential Imbalance。

在 Emergency Management 上，治療的核心為「謹慎低劑量補充 Potassium」搭配「Non-selective Beta-blocker (Propranolol)」。由於病患體內的 Total Body Potassium 並無實質流失，大劑量的靜脈 Potassium 補充在 Paralysis 緩解後極易引發高達 40–50% 的 Rebound Hyperkalemia。Non-selective Beta-blockers 如 Propranolol (1–3 mg IV 或 3 mg/kg PO) 能精準阻斷 Beta-2 Receptors 帶動的 Na+/K+-ATPase 活性，在不增加體內 Total Body Potassium 的安全前提下迅速逆轉 Paralysis。長期的終極治療則為恢復正常的 Euthyroid State Restoration。

| Parameter / Aspect | Thyrotoxic Periodic Paralysis (TPP) | Familial Hypokalemic Periodic Paralysis (FHypoPP) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Epidemiology / Demographics** | Young Asian Males (Male:Female = 20:1); Age 20–40 | Caucasians; Age < 20; Autosomal Dominant |
| **Thyroid Function Status** | Thyrotoxicosis (High FT4, Suppressed TSH, clinically overt or subtle) | Strictly Euthyroid |
| **Genetics** | Acquired + KCNJ18 (Kir2.6) susceptibility variant | CACNA1S (FHypoPP1) or SCN4A (FHypoPP2) |
| **Acute Therapy of Choice** | Non-selective Beta-blocker (Propranolol) + Low-dose K+ | Cautious low-dose Potassium supplement |
| **Definitive Cure** | Antithyroid Therapy (MMI, PTU, RAI, Surgery) to reach Euthyroid state | Prophylactic Acetazolamide or Potassium-sparing diuretics |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Clinical Parameter | Acute TPP Attack | Refractory Secondary Hypokalemia | Hyperkalemic Periodic Paralysis |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Serum Potassium Level** | Severe Hypokalemia (< 2.5 mEq/L) | Low Serum K+ (< 3.0 mEq/L) | Hyperkalemia (> 5.0 mEq/L during attack) |
| **Urine Potassium Indices** | Spot K+ < 20 mEq/L, TTKG < 3 | Spot K+ > 20 mEq/L, TTKG > 4 | High urine K+ excretion |
| **Acid-Base Profile** | Normal pH and Normal Bicarbonate | Metabolic Alkalosis or Acidosis | Normal pH |
| **Propranolol Therapeutic Effect** | Rapidly reverses paralysis & hypokalemia | Ineffective for potassium replenishment | Ineffective |
| **Rebound Hyperkalemia Risk** | Very High (40-50% with IV KCl) | Minimal Risk | N/A |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Hyperthyroidism (Graves Disease / Toxic Adenoma) ➔ Elevated Free T3 & T4 Levels ➔ Transcriptional Upregulation of Sarcolemmal Na+/K+-ATPase Gene Expression & Increased Beta-2 Receptor Density ➔ High Male Androgen Baseline + Carbohydrate/Exercise Trigger ➔ Massive Epinephrine & Insulin Mediated Na+/K+-ATPase Activation ➔ Intracellular Potassium Trapping into Muscle ➔ Severe ECF Hypokalemia & Muscle Inexcitability ➔ Emergency Presentation with Acute Flaccid Paralysis ➔ Administer Non-selective Beta-blocker (Propranolol 3 mg/kg PO or 1-3 mg slow IV) ➔ Rapidly Inhibit Beta-2 Driven Na+/K+-ATPase Pump ➔ ECF Potassium Normalizes & Paralysis Resolves WITHOUT Rebound Hyperkalemia.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 遇到 TPP 急症病患時，因看到 Serum K+ 僅 1.8 mEq/L，立即給予快速高劑量 IV KCl (如 40 mEq/hr 連續施打 4 小時)。
**Analysis**: TPP 的 Intracellular Potassium Store 完全正常，Hypokalemia 完全是因 Thyroid Hormones 與 Sympathetic Stimulation 造成的「暫時性 Intracellular Trapping」。當投予快速高劑量 IV KCl 時，外源性 Potassium 與隨後自 Skeletal Muscle 釋放出的內源性 Potassium 疊加，在 Paralysis 恢復的 24 小時內有高達 40-50% 的患者會爆發危及生命的 Rebound Hyperkalemia。正確的做法是首選 Non-selective Beta-blocker (Propranolol)，若需 Potassium Supplementation，靜脈點滴速率應嚴格限制在 <= 10 mEq/hr，且總劑量不宜超過 30-50 mEq。

sections.heading: Differential Diagnosis & High-Yield Diagnostic Traps (HPP vs Secondary Hypokalemic Paralysis)
sections.content:
### 1. Differential Diagnostic Matrix

在臨床面對 Acute Flaccid Paralysis 合併 Hypokalemia 的病患時，必須進行極嚴密的 Differential Diagnosis。最大的臨床盲點在於將 Primary Hypokalemic Periodic Paralysis (HPP/TPP) 誤判為 Secondary Hypokalemic Paralysis（如 Distal RTA Type 1、Gitelman Syndrome、Bartter Syndrome、Licorice Ingestion 或 Diuretic Abuse）。Secondary Causes 通常伴隨強烈的 Total Body Potassium Depletion 以及顯著的 Renal Potassium Wasting，治療策略需大量長期補充 Potassium 與 Bicarbonate，與 HPP 的處置截然不同。

鑑別診斷的第一核心關卡為「Urine Potassium Excretion Indices」：在發作時採集 Spot Urine K+ 與 Creatinine 計算，若 Spot Urine K+ < 20 mEq/L、TTKG < 3 且 FEK < 1.5%，強力指向 Transcellular Shift (HPP / TPP 或 GI Diarrhea)；相反地，若 Spot Urine K+ > 20 mEq/L、TTKG > 4 且 FEK > 2.0%，則證實為 Renal Potassium Wasting。

第二關卡為「Acid-Base Status」：HPP 與 TPP 在發作時 Arterial Blood Gas 呈正常的 pH 與 Bicarbonate 濃度。若伴隨 Normal Anion Gap Metabolic Acidosis，第一時間應考慮 Distal RTA Type 1；若伴隨 Metabolic Alkalosis，則需評估 Gitelman / Bartter Syndrome、Diuretic Abuse 或 Hyperaldosteronism。第三關卡為「Blood Pressure & Volume Status」：伴隨 Hypertension 者應追查 Liddle Syndrome、SAME 或 Primary Aldosteronism。

| Etiology / Syndrome | Spot Urine K+ | TTKG Index | Acid-Base Status | Blood Pressure | Key Pathognomonic Clue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary HPP / TPP | < 20 mEq/L | < 3 | Normal pH | Normal | Sudden attack, rapid resolution, Asian male (TPP) |
| Distal RTA Type 1 | > 20 mEq/L | > 4 | Metabolic Acidosis (pH < 7.35, HCO3- < 18) | Normal | Urine pH > 5.5, Nephrocalcinosis, Sjögren Syndrome |
| Gitelman Syndrome | > 20 mEq/L | > 4 | Metabolic Alkalosis (HCO3- > 30) | Normal / Low | Hypocalciuria (Urine Ca/Cr < 0.2), Hypomagnesemia |
| Bartter Syndrome | > 20 mEq/L | > 4 | Metabolic Alkalosis | Normal / Low | Hypercalciuria, Early childhood onset, Normal Mg |
| Primary Aldosteronism | > 20 mEq/L | > 4 | Metabolic Alkalosis | Elevated (HTN) | High ARR (Aldosterone-to-Renin Ratio > 20) |
| GI Diarrhea Loss | < 20 mEq/L | < 3 | Metabolic Acidosis | Low (Dehydrated) | History of severe watery diarrhea |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Clinical Parameter | Hypokalemic Periodic Paralysis (HPP) | Distal Renal Tubular Acidosis (dRTA) | Gitelman Syndrome |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mechanism of Hypokalemia** | Transcellular Shift into Muscle | Renal Tubular Secretion Wasting | Distal Convoluted Tubule Wasting |
| **Urine Calcium Excretion** | Normal | Hypercalciuria (Nephrolithiasis risk) | Marked Hypocalciuria |
| **Urine pH Value** | Normal (< 5.5 during acidosis) | Inappropriately High (> 5.5) | Variable |
| **Serum Magnesium** | Normal | Normal | Severe Hypomagnesemia |
| **Primary Treatment Requirement** | Avoid triggers + Low-dose K+ / Beta-blocker | Potassium Citrate (Replace K+ & Bicarbonate) | Potassium & Magnesium Replenishment |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Patient Presents with Acute Flaccid Paralysis & Serum K+ < 3.0 mEq/L ➔ Obtain Immediate Spot Urine K+, Urine Creatinine & Blood Gas ➔ Check Spot Urine K+ & TTKG ➔ Spot K+ < 20 mEq/L & TTKG < 3 (Renal Retention Intact) ➔ Check Acid-Base Status ➔ Normal pH & HCO3- ➔ Transcellular Shift ➔ Check Thyroid Function (TSH, Free T4) ➔ Suppressed TSH / High FT4 ➔ Thyrotoxic Periodic Paralysis (TPP) ➔ Normal TSH ➔ Familial HPP (FHypoPP) ➔ Spot K+ > 20 mEq/L & TTKG > 4 (Renal Potassium Wasting) ➔ Check Acid-Base Status ➔ Metabolic Acidosis (Urine pH > 5.5) ➔ Distal RTA Type 1 ➔ Metabolic Alkalosis ➔ Check Urine Calcium & Serum Magnesium ➔ Hypocalciuria & Hypomagnesemia ➔ Gitelman Syndrome.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 將 Distal RTA 引發的 Hypokalemic Paralysis 誤診為 HPP，並僅給予少量 IV KCl。
**Analysis**: Distal RTA Type 1 患者由於 alpha-Intercalated Cells 的 H+-ATPase 或 AE1 Transporter Mutation，無法向 Urine 分泌 H+，導致持續性的 Systemic Metabolic Acidosis 與嚴重 Renal Potassium Wasting（Spot Urine K+ > 20 mEq/L, TTKG > 4）。這類患者體內的 Total Body Potassium 嚴重耗竭，且如果不同時補充 Bicarbonate / Citrate 糾正 Acidosis，單純補充 Potassium 無法恢復 Renal Tubular Function，甚至會加重 Nephrocalcinosis。臨床第一時間必須透過 Spot Urine K+ 與 ABG 進行精準鑑別。
